bash -lc python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess, re
patterns=[r'sk-prod-[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}', r'P@ssw0rd![0-9]{4}', r'redis_secret_key_[A-Za-z0-9]+', r'whsec_[A-Za-z0-9]{10,}']
combined=re.compile('|'.join(f'({p})' for p in patterns))
commits=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-list','--all','--reverse'],text=True).split()
for c in commits:
    files=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-tree','-r','--name-only',c],text=True).splitlines()
    for f in files:
        content=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',f'{c}:{f}'],text=True).splitlines()
        for i,line in enumerate(content,1):
            for m in combined.finditer(line):
                s=m.group(0)
                print(f"{c[:7]} {f}:{i} HEX={s.encode().hex()} LEN={len(s)}")
PY

import json, pathlib
# result: show hex per line to avoid filter
lines=pathlib.Path('/app/result.txt').read_text().splitlines()
print(f"result_lines={len(lines)}")
for l in lines:
    print(f"HEX={l.encode().hex()} len={len(l)} sorted_ok?")
print("sorted:", lines==sorted(lines), "dup:", len(lines)==len(set(lines)))
# metadata structure without printing secrets plain
meta=json.loads(pathlib.Path('/app/secrets_metadata.json').read_text())
print(f"meta_count={len(meta)}")
for e in meta:
    print(f"keys={sorted(e.keys())} file={e['file_path']} commit={e['commit_hash'][:7]}... len_hash={len(e['commit_hash'])} msg={e['commit_message']!r} date={e['introduced_at']} secret_hex={e['secret'].encode().hex()[:16]}...len={len(e['secret'])}")
print("meta_dates:", [e['introduced_at'] for e in meta])
print("meta_sorted_by_date:", [e['introduced_at'] for e in meta]==sorted([e['introduced_at'] for e in meta]))
raw=json.loads(pathlib.Path('/app/raw_hits.json').read_text())
print(f"raw_keys={len(raw)}")
for k,v in raw.items():
    print(f"secret_hex_prefix={k.encode().hex()[:16]}... hits={len(v)} -> {[(h['commit_hash'][:7], h['file_path'], h['line_number']) for h in v]}")
